name: University of Newcastle Shaping Futures Full Degree Scholarship
summary: Multi-year scholarship for first-year UON undergraduates facing educational disadvantage such as caring duties or financial hardship.
key: A total benefit of up to $25,000, up to a maximum term of 5 years.
who: Enrolled in first year of a UON undergraduate degree
Able to show educational disadvantage such as caring or sole parent duties, financial hardship or a long-term medical condition
how: Apply through the online portal (PDF uploads only)

source.label: University of Newcastle: Shaping Futures Full Degree Scholarship

evidence.quote: This scholarship provides a total benefit of up to $25,000, up to a maximum term of 5 years.
The scholarship provides $5000 annually, paid as a lump sum in Semester 1 each year.
Be enrolled in 1st year of an undergraduate degree program with the University of Newcastle.
